```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

```



```{r}

df <- read.csv("sample_gf_ga_data.csv")

avg_df <- df %>%
  group_by(TEAM) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_GFPG = mean(GFPG),
    avg_GAPG = mean(GAPG)
  )

long_df <- avg_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_GFPG, avg_GAPG), names_to = "Type", values_to = "Value")

long_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(TEAM) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Value / sum(Value))

```


```{r}

ggplot(long_df, aes(x = reorder(TEAM, -Percent), y = Percent, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("avg_GFPG" = "#1f77b4", "avg_GAPG" = "#d62728"),
    labels = c("Goals For Per Game", "Goals Against Per Game")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Balance of Scoring vs. Defense by NHL Team (Avg GFPG vs. GAPG)",
    subtitle = "Average: 2021–2022 to 2024-2025 Regular Seasons",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of Total Goals",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("gfpg_gapg_100pct_chart.png", width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```
